current_prompt.body:
READ the list L of 45 distinct positive integers.
EVALUATE whether L can be partitioned into 15 disjoint triples (a_i, b_i, c_i) such that a_i + b_i = c_i for each triple i ∈ {1,...,15}.
IF a valid partition exists THEN
    PROVIDE one complete example of such a partition.
ENDIF

current_plan.body:
READ the list L of 45 distinct positive integers
GENERATE candidate triples (a, b, c) from L where a + b = c
SEARCH for a collection of 15 disjoint candidate triples that together include every element of L
IF a collection of 15 disjoint triples is found THEN
    OUTPUT one example partition consisting of the 15 triples
ENDIF
